# 07_Workflows

## Purpose

Workflow orchestration — runner, state management, logs, and reports.

## Subdirectories

| Directory | Content | Generated By |
|-----------|---------|--------------|
| `logs/` | Workflow run logs | `workflow_runner.py` |
| `reports/` | Workflow reports (JSON/MD) | `workflow_runner.py` |

## Auto-Generated Content

- `logs/*.log` — timestamped workflow logs
- `reports/workflow_report.json` — latest run report
- `workflow_state.json` — workflow state
- `workflow_failures.jsonl` — failure records

## User Editing

**No** — logs and reports are auto-generated. Workflow Python files are source code.
